changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.sql: -- The pre-upgrade procedure stops all server replicas. Locks keep the cutover atomic with its data moves. LOCK TABLE agent_action, mentor_entry IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; -- This one-time cutover moves immutable legacy payloads/outcomes. Restore the runtime guard before commit. ALTER TABLE agent_action DISABLE TRIGGER agent_action_lifecycle; INSERT INTO agent_action(id,workspace_id,kind,lane_key,idempotency_key,state,payload,subject_account_id, attempts,max_attempts,next_attempt_at,lease_epoch,stop_reason,created_at,updated_at,ended_at) SELECT uuidv7(),e.workspace_id,'SLACK_POST',k.key,k.key, CASE WHEN e.slack_delivery='DELIVERED' THEN 'DONE' WHEN e.slack_delivery='FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'UNCERTAIN' END, NULL,c.account_id,1,3,clock_timestamp(),0, CASE WHEN e.slack_delivery='DELIVERED' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN e.slack_delivery='FAILED' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'WRITE_UNCONFIRMED' END, e.created_at,clock_timestamp(),clock_timestamp() FROM mentor_entry e JOIN mentor_conversation c ON c.id=e.conversation_id AND c.workspace_id=e.workspace_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN e.kind='DIGEST' THEN 'slack_digest:' ELSE 'slack_reply:' END || e.id AS key) k WHERE e.redacted_at IS NULL AND e.slack_delivery IS NOT NULL AND (e.kind='DIGEST' OR (e.kind='USER' AND e.surface='SLACK')) ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO NOTHING; -- An old owner could have opened a stream without metadata or without recording its receipt. Never post it again. UPDATE agent_action SET state='UNCERTAIN',payload=NULL,leased_until=NULL,ended_at=clock_timestamp(), stop_reason='WRITE_UNCONFIRMED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE kind='SLACK_POST' AND ended_at IS NULL AND ((payload->>'taken')::boolean IS TRUE OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mentor_entry e WHERE e.id=(payload->>'entryId')::uuid AND e.workspace_id=agent_action.workspace_id AND e.slack_stream_ts IS NOT NULL)); UPDATE agent_action SET payload=payload-'taken',next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE kind='SLACK_POST' AND payload IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(payload, 'taken'); ALTER TABLE agent_action ENABLE TRIGGER agent_action_lifecycle;

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup to recover the old Slack delivery schema and payloads.
